newsitem.title: USA: Chyron to take $2 mln Q2 cost-cutting charge.
newsitem.headline: Chyron to take $2 mln Q2 cost-cutting charge.

text.p: Chyron Corp said Friday it expects to record a second quarter charge of about $2.0 million due to cost-cutting measures that includes staff reassignments and reductions affecting about 5.0 percent of its personnel.

In a statement, Chryron said its chairman and chief executive officer, Michael Wellesley-Wesley disclosed the effects of the cost-cutting measures at the company's annual shareholder meeting on May 14.

According to the statement, Chyron's management adopted what it called "cost-effective" steps in a move to return the company to profitability. It said the action was taken after a board meeting that followed the annual meeting.

Wellesley-Wesley told shareholders that the company is "examining all options to ensure that the second half of 1997 is one of recovery to profitability" and that the company will take all steps necessary, it said.
